sections.detail: Diamond Creek (Grand Canyon): Research-only grade: access-verified (official source names boating access; approximate area only). Access crosses Hualapai tribal land and the Tribe charges its own fees; the managing authority for road and landing is the Hualapai Tribe, not NPS, so this stays in the access-verified tier.

Dry Canyon Boat Take-Out (Gila Box): Closure-uncertain: a non-agency (American Whitewater) report dated Oct 4, 2026 describes a road washout on the take-out access; no BLM notice was found either way. The BLM page coordinate is more than 400 m from any NHD Gila River flowline (no flowline in the 0.004-degree NHD query).

Blue Point Day Use Area (Lower Salt): Research-only grade: access-verified (official source names boating access; approximate area only). Imagery: the point is in the day-use parking lot about 110 m east of the river channel. v1.3: North's owner-supplied point (33.5539720, -111.5750868) is at the water's edge on the beach just south of the Bush Highway bridge (NHD 49 m, river right), but that beach is on the Pebble Beach side of the highway (175 m from the Pebble Beach page coordinate, 193 m from the Blue Point one), so it was not applied. v1.4: reassessed with North's statement that Sheeps Crossing is the other side (his Sheeps point is river-left, 432 m away) and the USFS INFRA site points (Pebble Beach 95705 serves the south lots; Blue Point 95316 is the lot north of the highway); still not applied (research/replacement-proposals-AZ.json). Official source names boating access, but the exact water-entry point is not pinned by an agency coordinate confirmed on imagery.

Goldfield Day Use Area (Lower Salt): Research-only grade: access-verified (official source names boating access; approximate area only). Agency point is 257 m from the NHD centreline (>150 m). Tonto order 03-12-03-24-65 closes a described Goldfield-area eagle zone Dec 1-Jun 30 each year (order text runs to Jun 30, 2026; renewal for 2026-27 not found this pass).

First Campground (Upper Salt put-in): No managing-agency coordinate: the launch is on White Mountain Apache land (tribal permit required); the Tonto NF area map PDF is image-only and gives no coordinates. Highway 288 Bridge Take-out (Upper Salt): Tonto NF names the take-out (just downstream of the Highway 288 Bridge, river left) but publishes no coordinate for it.

Needle Rock Day Use Area (Verde): The page names a non-motorized beach and lists non-motorized boating, but it never says launch/put-in, so it stays pending. Box Bar River Access Point (Verde): Imagery: the Tonto page coordinate is in the dispersed parking/camping flat about 120 m west of the river.

Tuzigoot River Access Point (Verde): No agency coordinate for the launch itself (Clarkdale page 403 to curl; text captured via WebFetch fallback; AZSP gives only the park-entrance coordinate). Dead Horse Ranch State Park River Day Use Area (Verde): No agency coordinate for the river day-use landing (the Dead Horse facility page's boat ramp is at the lagoons, not the river).
